# Skip link

The first focusable element: goes past the header to the main content.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: HTML `<a href="#main">`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **link**: Hidden until focused, then shown on top.

## Variants

- `default`: Skip to content.

## States

- `focus-visible`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | First stop on the page. |
| Enter | Moves focus to the main content. |

## Accessibility

- Role: link
- Name: "Skip to content", localized.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
